Third-party libraries used by the scroll animations (assets/js/perla-motion.js).

GSAP 3.15.1 (gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js, SplitText.min.js)
  https://gsap.com
  Copyright GreenSock / Webflow. Unmodified "dist" files of the official "gsap" package
  (https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap), subject to GSAP's standard "no charge" license:
  https://gsap.com/standard-license

Lenis 1.3.27 (lenis.min.js)
  https://lenis.darkroom.engineering
  Copyright darkroom.engineering. "dist" file of the official "lenis" package
  (https://www.npmjs.com/package/lenis), MIT license: see lenis-LICENSE.txt. The only change is
  the removal of the source map comment on its last line.

To update a library, replace its files with the ones of a newer package and change the version
number in inc/motion.php.
